description: Adversarial multi-step checkout, login, and profile HTML form DOM corpus covering obscure ARIA labels, split phone/CC/expiry inputs, shadow/nested labels, misleading autocomplete attributes, billing vs shipping collisions, and false-positive substrings.

scenarios.description: ARIA-only inputs, multi-node aria-labelledby, verbose nested label helper text, (optional)/(required) suffixes, and placeholder-only ZIP.
scenarios.html:
First Name
(as shown on ID)

scenarios.description: Declarative Shadow DOM address inputs and deeply nested label wrappers.
Address Line 1 vs Address Line 2 (Apt, suite, unit) must not match Line 2 to Street Line 1.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="addr1">Street address (Line 1) *</label><input id="addr1" name="address1" autocomplete="address-line1" required><label for="addr2">Address line 2 (Apt, suite, unit, building)</label><input id="addr2" name="address2" autocomplete="address-line2"><label for="apt_only">Apt / Suite (optional)</label><input id="apt_only" name="apt"><label for="city1">City</label><input id="city1" name="city" autocomplete="address-level2"></form>

scenarios.description: Split 3-box US phone inputs with tel-area-code/prefix/suffix autocomplete must remain ambiguous rather than dumping full phone into each box.
scenarios.html: <form><fieldset><legend>Phone Number</legend><input id="tel_area" type="tel" maxlength="3" autocomplete="tel-area-code" aria-label="Area code"><input id="tel_prefix" type="tel" maxlength="3" autocomplete="tel-local-prefix" aria-label="Phone prefix"><input id="tel_line" type="tel" maxlength="4" autocomplete="tel-local-suffix" aria-label="Phone line number"></fieldset><label for="full_phone">Backup Phone</label><input id="full_phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel"></form>

scenarios.description: Split Phone (Part 1/2/3) without autocomplete must remain ambiguous, never blindly matched to a single phone record.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="p1">Phone (Part 1)</label><input id="p1" type="tel" maxlength="3"><label for="p2">Phone (Part 2)</label><input id="p2" type="tel" maxlength="3"><label for="p3">Phone (Part 3)</label><input id="p3" type="tel" maxlength="4"><label for="cc_dial">Country dialing code</label><input id="cc_dial" type="tel" maxlength="4" autocomplete="tel-country-code"></form>

scenarios.description: Split 4-box credit card number, split expiration month/year, CVV, and Name on Card must ALL route to financial, never profile memory.
scenarios.html: <form><fieldset><legend>Card Number</legend><input id="cc1" type="text" maxlength="4" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Card digits 1 to 4"><input id="cc2" type="text" maxlength="4" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Card digits 5 to 8"><input id="cc3" type="text" maxlength="4" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Card digits 9 to 12"><input id="cc4" type="text" maxlength="4" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Card digits 13 to 16"></fieldset><label for="exp_m">Exp Month</label><select id="exp_m" autocomplete="cc-exp-month"><option value="01">01</option></select><label for="exp_y">Exp Year</label><select id="exp_y" autocomplete="cc-exp-year"><option value="2029">2029</option></select><label for="cvv">CVV / CVC</label><input id="cvv" type="text" maxlength="4" autocomplete="cc-csc"><label for="cc_holder">Name on card</label><input id="cc_holder" type="text" autocomplete="cc-name"></form>

scenarios.description: Combined card & bank payment form without autocomplete attributes must still classify all payment fields as financial.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="card_num">Credit Card Number *</label><input id="card_num" type="text" required><label for="exp_mmyy">Expiration Date (MM / YY)</label><input id="exp_mmyy" type="text" placeholder="MM/YY"><label for="card_cid">Card Security Code (CID)</label><input id="card_cid" type="text" maxlength="4"><label for="bank_rt">Bank Routing Number</label><input id="bank_rt" type="text"><label for="iban">IBAN</label><input id="iban" type="text"></form>

scenarios.description: Anti-autofill hacks (autocomplete=new-password/off/nope/chrome-off on ordinary address/contact text inputs) must NOT block matching or misclassify as credential.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="anti_street">Street Address</label><input id="anti_street" type="text" autocomplete="new-password"><label for="anti_email">Email Address</label><input id="anti_email" type="email" autocomplete="off"><label for="anti_city">City</label><input id="anti_city" type="text" autocomplete="nope"><label for="anti_zip">Postal Code</label><input id="anti_zip" type="text" autocomplete="chrome-off"><label for="anti_state">State</label><input id="anti_state" type="text" autocomplete="do-not-autofill"></form>

scenarios.description: Conflicting autocomplete vs explicit label (Promo Code with one-time-code) and obscure generic labels disambiguated by semantic autocomplete/type.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="promo_tricky">Promo Code</label><input id="promo_tricky" type="text" name="coupon" autocomplete="one-time-code"><label for="obscure_cc">Number</label><input id="obscure_cc" type="text" autocomplete="cc-number" inputmode="numeric"><label for="obscure_otp">Code</label><input id="obscure_otp" type="text" autocomplete="one-time-code" inputmode="numeric"><label for="obscure_pw">Enter secret</label><input id="obscure_pw" type="password" autocomplete="current-password"><label for="obscure_zip">Location</label><input id="obscure_zip" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code"></form>

scenarios.description: Substring traps: Statement number (contains 'state'), Footpath access notes (contains 'otp'), Original order reference (contains 'origin'), Gift recipient email, Name on card.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="stmt_no">Statement number</label><input id="stmt_no" type="text"><label for="footpath">Footpath access notes</label><textarea id="footpath"></textarea><label for="orig_ref">Original order reference</label><input id="orig_ref" type="text"><label for="gift_email">Gift recipient email</label><input id="gift_email" type="email"><label for="card_name">Name on card</label><input id="card_name" type="text"></form>

scenarios.description: Multi-step login + MFA + consent + coupon form with single_home profile.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="login_user">Username or Email</label><input id="login_user" type="text" autocomplete="username"><label for="login_pass">Password</label><input id="login_pass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password"><label for="mfa_code">6-digit authenticator code</label><input id="mfa_code" type="text" autocomplete="one-time-code" inputmode="numeric"><label for="tos_chk"><input id="tos_chk" type="checkbox">I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy</label><label for="mkt_chk"><input id="mkt_chk" type="checkbox">Email me product marketing updates</label><label for="coupon_box">Discount / Coupon code</label><input id="coupon_box" type="text"></form>

scenarios.description: Prefixed Shipping + Billing address fields on one checkout page with single_home profile preserve section and resolve cleanly.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="ship_street">Shipping Street Address</label><input id="ship_street" name="shipping_street"><label for="ship_city">Shipping City</label><input id="ship_city" name="shipping_city"><label for="ship_state">Shipping State</label><input id="ship_state" name="shipping_state"><label for="ship_zip">Shipping ZIP Code</label><input id="ship_zip" name="shipping_zip"><label for="bill_street">Billing Street Address</label><input id="bill_street" name="billing_street"><label for="bill_city">Billing City</label><input id="bill_city" name="billing_city"><label for="bill_state">Billing State</label><input id="bill_state" name="billing_state"><label for="bill_zip">Billing ZIP Code</label><input id="bill_zip" name="billing_zip"></form>

scenarios.description: Identical unprefixed labels inside separate Shipping and Billing fieldsets with section-qualified autocomplete attributes.
scenarios.html: <form><fieldset><legend>Shipping Address</legend><label for="s_addr">Street address</label><input id="s_addr" autocomplete="shipping street-address"><label for="s_city">City</label><input id="s_city" autocomplete="shipping address-level2"><label for="s_zip">ZIP Code</label><input id="s_zip" autocomplete="shipping postal-code"><label for="s_country">Country</label><input id="s_country" autocomplete="shipping country"></fieldset><fieldset><legend>Billing Address</legend><label for="b_addr">Street address</label><input id="b_addr" autocomplete="billing street-address"><label for="b_city">City</label><input id="b_city" autocomplete="billing address-level2"><label for="b_zip">ZIP Code</label><input id="b_zip" autocomplete="billing postal-code"><label for="b_country">Country</label><input id="b_country" autocomplete="billing country"></fieldset></form>

scenarios.description: Dual Shipping + Billing checkout with two equal address groups (home and work) keeps every component ambiguous with section metadata preserved.
scenarios.html: <form><fieldset><legend>Shipping Address</legend><label for="sh2_street">Street address</label><input id="sh2_street" autocomplete="shipping street-address"><label for="sh2_city">City</label><input id="sh2_city" autocomplete="shipping address-level2"><label for="sh2_zip">ZIP Code</label><input id="sh2_zip" autocomplete="shipping postal-code"></fieldset><fieldset><legend>Billing Address</legend><label for="bi2_street">Street address</label><input id="bi2_street" autocomplete="billing street-address"><label for="bi2_city">City</label><input id="bi2_city" autocomplete="billing address-level2"><label for="bi2_zip">ZIP Code</label><input id="bi2_zip" autocomplete="billing postal-code"></fieldset></form>

scenarios.description: Shipping checkout with primary home group + 'Billing address same as shipping' checkbox (must NOT match street) + delivery instructions + terms consent.
scenarios.html: <form><fieldset><legend>Shipping Address</legend><label for="sp_street">Shipping Street</label><input id="sp_street"><label for="sp_city">Shipping City</label><input id="sp_city"><label for="sp_zip">Shipping Postal Code</label><input id="sp_zip"></fieldset><label for="same_bill"><input id="same_bill" type="checkbox">Billing address same as shipping</label><label for="deliv_notes">Delivery instructions</label><textarea id="deliv_notes"></textarea><label for="terms_ok"><input id="terms_ok" type="checkbox">Accept Terms of Service</label></form>

scenarios.description: Empty vault profile form cleanly separates missing profile fields, payment fields, consent, and task-specific notes.
scenarios.html: <form><label for="e_full">Full name *</label><input id="e_full" required><label for="e_mail">Email address *</label><input id="e_mail" type="email" required><label for="e_cc">Card number</label><input id="e_cc" autocomplete="cc-number"><label for="e_gift">Gift message</label><textarea id="e_gift"></textarea><label for="e_optin"><input id="e_optin" type="checkbox">Opt in to promotional emails</label></form>
